text: Nishan-e-Pakistan (Urdu: نشانِ پاکستان, lit. 'Order of Pakistan') is the highest civilian honor of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. It is conferred upon individuals who have rendered services of the highest distinction to Pakistan's national interest, and it is awarded to both government officials and civilians, including Pakistani citizens and foreign nationals. Within the Pakistan honours system, Nishan-e-Pakistan is equivalent to Nishan-e-Haider, the highest military gallantry award. The award was established on 19 March 1975 under the Decorations Act, 1975, and is not based on a person's rank or status. Announcements of the award, along with other civilian honors, occur annually on Independence Day (14 August), and the investiture ceremony is held on the following Pakistan Resolution Day (23 March) by the President of Pakistan. The award may also be bestowed posthumously, and all recipients are entitled to the post-nominal NPk.
